text:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm doing a light sweep of the onboarding tutorial (the tiny 'first app' flow). Found two broken doc links and one JS auth snippet that doesn't match current SDK usage. I'll open PRs today.

alex: Thanks — can you paste the broken links here so I can triage routing?

maria: Sure. 
- Broken links: https://docs.redwood.ai/intro -> 404, and the container deploy link points to an old repo.
- Snippet issue: tutorial shows `Authorization: Token <KEY>` header while our SDK expects `Authorization: Bearer <KEY>`. Small but confusing.

sam: I can own updating the JS snippets. Prefer we switch examples to the new simple client constructor (`new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })`) and remove raw header examples.

maria: That would be great. Also want to standardize the Python snippet to use the `Client` class we shipped last quarter. Example I'm planning to push:

```python
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.environ[\"RW_API_KEY\"]) 
resp = client.generate(\"Hello from my first app\")
print(resp.text)
```

sam: looks good. For JS I'll use this pattern in the docs PR:

```js
import RedwoodClient from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate('Hello app');
console.log(res.text);
```

docs-bot: Automated note: docs PR created by maria -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 (fix: links + auth snippets) :robot_face:

linda: Heads-up from localization — the broken link is referenced in the translated Chinese copy. I'll patch the localized pages after the upstream link update.

alex: Can we also add a tiny smoke test in the CI that verifies example snippets compile/run? Maybe a lint job that imports the example client. Not required for this PR but a follow-up.

maria: Good idea. For this PR I'll: 1) replace raw header examples with client constructors, 2) update the two links, 3) add a short note about "first deployment" steps pointing to the new container guide.

sam: I'll review the snippet changes in the morning.

maria: PR is up and ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412

alex: quick nit — can we rephrase the auth paragraph to "set RW_API_KEY in env" instead of suggesting copying key into source? security nits.

sam: yep will change that line.

maria: Thanks all — merging after CI passes. :shipit:

docs-bot: PR merged by maria into main (CI: green) — live on staging docs.

linda: I'll start the localized fix pass now, linking to the new staging pages.

alex: Thanks everyone, nice quick turnaround.
